Direct callee of the exact 080bbb0c battle-command owner.
The complete control flow, destructive count loop, 76-byte local layout, summon-slot sentinel handling, placement call, and exact battle-motion lookup are expressed.

A bounded 50,000-candidate classic heat-guided walk found no exact candidate and did not improve the real byte delta; packed structural scores favored shorter but bytewise-equivalent-or-worse candidates and were rejected.

A fresh fixed-route rebuild on 2026-08-25 first improved the earlier measured draft from 156/69/60 to 152 candidate bytes, 70 differing halfwords, and 50 wrong instructions against the 148-byte reference.
The 136-byte relocation-masked core remains identical in JA, EN, DE, ES, FR, and IT at the recorded starts. This is shared machine-code evidence, not exact-C correspondence.

Readable raw-pointer, split-assignment, independent byte-offset, direct-sentinel, reversed-addend, carrier-width, and declaration-lifetime spellings were rebuilt. The best either reproduces 152/70/50 or regresses to 156/69/60; none changes the key pointer fold under the fixed route.

A bounded compiler-axis sweep found no narrow residual: -fno-schedule-insns2, -fno-cse-follow-jumps, -fno-cse-skip-blocks, -fno-regmove, and -fno-expensive-optimizations tie 152/70/50; -fno-gcse is 132/71/74; -fno-strength-reduce is 156/71/66; old-agbcc is 144/72/112. -fno-rerun-cse-after-loop reaches exact extent 148 but remains broad at 60 differing halfwords and 56 wrong instructions.

The exact 080bbb0c source was preprocessed through its registered route and supplied to m2c as context. It establishes this direct callee's void signature, but the generated machine-shaped seed still required recovered aggregate types and did not compile as emitted; its raw-pointer spelling regressed when repaired with ordinary types.

A valid 5,000-candidate safe heat-guided walk biased by the exact 080bbb0c source found one semantics-preserving source fact: retaining an explicit zero slot for the first summon read. Pared to the ordinary slot local and independently rescored, it improves the canonical draft from 152/70/50 to exact extent at 148 candidate bytes, 21 differing halfwords, and 32 wrong instructions.

An earlier apparent 152/66 improvement was discarded because the AST preprocessor had deleted __attribute__((packed)) and moved the placement payload from offset 2 to offset 4. The permuter now preserves GNU layout attributes and has a regression test for this owner class.

A subsequent 20,000-candidate classic exact-only walk found no improvement or exact output. Repeating the approved pass matrix on the improved source ties at 148/21/32 or regresses; 080bbb0c's -fno-cse-follow-jumps route is byte-neutral here. The direct m2c base-pointer and explicit dual-offset source models regress to 152/70/50 and 156/70/52 respectively.

The remaining equal-length residual is fifteen normalized instruction choices: placement+2 and gather-loop register allocation, two commutative indexed-load encodings, and the return-pop register. Adoption still requires zero differing halfwords; no permanent classification is inferred from this bounded negative result.
